findings.body: For every explicit window longer than 120 months, this fallback replaces the requested window with only the span between the first and last active Actual pin. That silently drops requested leading and trailing months, although the budget-state definition requires an ungrouped row to cover every month of the explicit answer window. For example, a 2016–2026 request with only a July 2026 Actual pin and Budget batch is treated as loaded and its comparison runs, despite the other requested months having no Budget. Reject an over-limit explicit range or perform a bounded availability query without changing which months the row covers; the new extreme-window test currently enshrines the incorrect success case.
findings.title: Not done: explicit budget ranges assess every month in the answer window

findings.body: Budget availability and the early no-budget return now run before `statementRequest` at line 624. Consequently, an unwindowed statement comparison examines every active Actual month globally and can return the no-budget informational response merely because one historical month lacks Budget, without offering the statement's available period choices—even when a selectable period such as July has Budget loaded. Defer this decision until the statement period has been resolved.
findings.title: Resolve a statement period before returning the no-budget answer

findings.body: The Ask selection schema still accepts arbitrary `timeWindow.from` and `to` strings (`backend/src/saved/saved.schemas.ts:53-54`). If parsing makes `monthCount` non-finite, this new call sends those raw values to the warehouse before the guarded execution block. A malformed budget-bearing request can therefore cause a database date error to escape `ask()` instead of producing a governed response. Validate real date-only values before performing these metadata reads.
findings.title: Validate date strings before the new metadata lookup

findings.body: The backend emits `plantNames`, `budgetStates`, and `leftOut`, but the unchanged Ask UI does not consume them. Its informational branch (`frontend/src/features/assistant/ask-panel.tsx:238-243`) also renders only `definition`, so the new no-budget `message` produces a blank answer; null Budget/% cells still lack the required accessible labels and no plant or left-out readout is shown. The Tasks table assigns this presentation work to MP-ASK-UI-RESULTS.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-UI-RESULTS must render the new answer metadata

findings.body: The current presentation path still recognizes only the single-dimension `gl_code` and `leaf_key` shapes (`answerRowShape` at lines 1059-1084). Thus `gl_code × plant` and `leaf_key × plant` receive no per-row labels or drill context, while the required inert month shapes are not proven through the shared composite key. The Tasks table assigns this remaining Done-when 7 work to MP-ASK-DRILL.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-DRILL must support composite row identities
